Postpartum Depression Treatment
What We Treat
Postpartum Depression Treatment

Welcoming a new life into the world is a profound and joyous experience. However, this period can also bring unexpected challenges and emotional struggles for many parents. Postpartum depression (PPD) is a serious condition that can affect new mothers and fathers, making it challenging to embrace the joys of parenthood fully. At Garden Springs Wellness Center in Englewood, NJ, we understand the unique challenges that come with postpartum depression, and we are here to help.
Our dedicated team provides compassionate, evidence-based mental health treatment in New Jersey tailored to each individual’s unique needs.
What is Postpartum Depression

Postpartum depression is a complex and often misunderstood condition that occurs after childbirth. Unlike the “baby blues,” which are temporary and typically resolve within two weeks, postpartum depression is a more severe form of depression that can persist for months if left untreated. It can affect anyone who has recently given birth, regardless of age, background, or circumstances.
Common Signs and Symptoms of Postpartum Depression

runs.t: Common Signs and Symptoms of Postpartum Depression

blocks.text: Persistent feelings of sadness, hopelessness, or emptiness
Excessive crying or tearfulness
Severe mood swings or irritability
Difficulty bonding with the baby
Withdrawal from family and friends
Loss of interest in activities once enjoyed
Changes in appetite, weight, or sleep patterns
Extreme fatigue or loss of energy
Feelings of worthlessness, guilt, or shame
Difficulty concentrating or making decisions
Thoughts of harming oneself or the baby

If you or someone you know is experiencing these symptoms, it is crucial to seek professional help. Learning the difference between emotional burnout and depression can also help people better understand when emotional exhaustion may need more support. Postpartum depression is a serious condition that requires medical attention, but it is also entirely treatable with the proper support and care.

blocks.text: Treatment Options for Postpartum Depression

At Garden Springs Wellness Center, we offer a comprehensive range of treatment options designed to address the unique needs of individuals experiencing postpartum depression. Our multidisciplinary team collaborates to create personalized treatment plans that promote healing and recovery.

For individuals with severe postpartum depression or those at risk of harming themselves or others, inpatient mental health treatment in NJ provides a safe and supportive environment where they can receive intensive care. Our inpatient program includes round-the-clock monitoring, medication management, individual and group therapy, and support services to stabilize mood and improve overall well-being.

Our Partial Day Program offers a structured and supportive environment for individuals who need more than outpatient treatment but do not require 24-hour care. Participants attend therapy sessions and receive medical care during the day, allowing them to return home in the evenings. This program helps individuals maintain a balance between treatment and daily responsibilities.

Our mental health IOP program at Garden Springs Wellness Center provides flexible yet intensive treatment for postpartum depression. IOP is ideal for individuals who need substantial support but wish to maintain their daily routines. The program includes individual therapy, group therapy, medication management, and skills training to promote coping strategies and resilience.

Outpatient mental health treatment is suitable for individuals with mild to moderate postpartum depression who can manage their symptoms while remaining engaged in daily life. Our outpatient services include individual therapy, counseling, medication management, and support groups. This option allows for ongoing treatment and support while individuals continue their regular activities.

Medication can be an essential component of postpartum depression treatment. Our experienced psychiatrists work closely with individuals to evaluate their needs and prescribe appropriate medications. Antidepressants, mood stabilizers, and other medications can help alleviate symptoms and improve overall functioning. Medication management involves regular monitoring to ensure effectiveness and address any side effects.

Counseling is a cornerstone of effective postpartum depression treatment. Our compassionate therapists use evidence-based approaches to help individuals explore their feelings, identify negative thought patterns, and develop healthier coping mechanisms. Different types of counseling offered at Garden Springs Wellness Center include:
Cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT): A structured approach that identifies and changes negative thought patterns and behaviors.

blocks.text: What to Expect from Stress Management Programs at Garden Springs Wellness Center

At Garden Springs Wellness Center, we are dedicated to providing a nurturing and supportive environment for individuals seeking treatment for postpartum depression. When you choose our center, you can expect:
Upon arrival, our team thoroughly assesses your specific symptoms, history, and needs. This evaluation helps us develop a personalized treatment plan for your unique situation.

Your treatment plan is tailored to your needs and may include a combination of therapy, medication management, and support services. Our multidisciplinary team collaborates to ensure a holistic approach to your care.

We use proven, evidence-based therapies to treat postpartum depression effectively. These therapies include Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Interpersonal Therapy (IPT), and other modalities that have demonstrated success in treating depression.

We strive to create a warm and welcoming environment where you feel safe and valued. Our team is here to support you every step of the way, providing encouragement and understanding as you work toward recovery.

We recognize the importance of involving family members in the treatment process. Family therapy sessions and educational programs help loved ones understand postpartum depression and provide essential support.

At Garden Springs Wellness Center, we believe in treating the whole person. In addition to traditional therapies, we offer holistic services such as nutrition counseling, mindfulness practices, and wellness activities to promote overall well-being.
Paying for Postpartum Depression Treatment
Understanding the financial aspect of treatment can be challenging, but we are here to help you navigate the process. Garden Springs Wellness Center accepts various insurance plans, including:

Preferred Provider Organization (PPO): PPO plans offer flexibility in choosing healthcare providers and typically cover some treatment costs at Garden Springs Wellness Center. You can see specialists without a referral and may receive partial reimbursement for out-of-network services.
